note: Which SUBSTRATE each gauntlet campaign's transactions actually ran on. `bindings.json` says a campaign drove a route; it does not say whether the thing that executed the route was Solana devnet, a `solana-test-validator`, or an in-process `solana-program-test` bank. Those are three different evidence levels (AGENTS.md, 'Correctness vocabulary'; tools/gauntlet/DESIGN.md admits ProgramTest only as a labelled fast lane) and until this file existed the register could not print the difference, so 53% of the witnessed rows read exactly like the 19 that reach a validator. One file, one owner (lane WITNESS), because a substrate declared inside each campaign's own bindings.json would be the campaign grading its own evidence. Every declaration here is CHECKED against its producer by tools/genref/generate.mjs: `local-validator` must spawn one, `program-test` must not, and a campaign with no row is a hard error rather than a silent `unknown`. Each row also states whether the campaign REPRODUCES: `reproducible` is true, or a sentence saying what stops it. A binding is a claim about a run that happened, and a claim whose run cannot be repeated is not corroboration -- the C-16 rehearsal's finding (b), that 25 routes' sole witness was a campaign refusing at HEAD, was only findable by trying to run it. Now the register prints it.

classes.devnet: A finalized transaction on Solana devnet, named by signature and slot. The only class that is chain evidence outside this machine. Contract item 5 (docs/MASTER_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md:52-53) is met by this or by `local-validator`.
classes.local-validator: A `solana-test-validator` process: a real Agave runtime, a real ledger, real slots and finalization, on localhost.
classes.program-test: An in-process `solana-program-test` bank. It executes REAL SBF ELFs, which is why these campaigns are evidence at all, but it is not a validator: no packet limit, no leader schedule, no finalization, and no fee market. A route whose only witness is this class has never been exercised by a runtime that could refuse it for size or for time.
classes.reproducible: Whether the campaign completes at HEAD. `true` means it was observed to run end to end; a sentence means it does not, and says where it stops. Not a claim that anyone ran it today: it is an authored field, and it goes stale the same way every authored field does. What it is for is that a campaign which STOPS reproducing has somewhere to say so, which it did not before.

The infrastructure floor: a transaction-only bootstrap of the seven successor artifacts on a fresh localhost ledger. Twenty-five routes have no other witness. Unparked 2026-09-03 (58783f739); the campaign's own last transaction is the only thing between it and evidence again. Its bindings are ALSO older than the campaign they bind -- the founding was split after they were written, so seven labels have moved (Found31 -> Found37, one DCLTPCB1 step -> DCLTCFQ1 + DCLTPCB2 + DCLTCF1A) and the five `freeze * routing table` transactions are unbound. Nothing has reported that, because `census observe` runs only on a campaign that completes.
campaigns.reproducible: NO, as of 2026-09-03, and the refusal is now localized rather than named. The tier is not parked: it builds seven ELFs, launches a validator and submits 195 transactions in 24 minutes (28m35s end to end from a cold --work, inside the 25-31 minute budget), through every infrastructure-floor route and hostile, the Found37 Market, the funding prepare (DCLTCFQ1), the DCLTCF1A checkpoint hostile and the DCLTGMF3 hostile. Its LAST transaction, the atomic founding 'found the Market atomically: Lock, Found, Realize, Claims, Open (DCLTGMF3)', fails simulation with Claims 0x518D ClaimsFoundingSbfErrorV5::PermitBody after about 63,000 CU in Claims and 627,000 in Trading, and the validator log now carries the conjunct: FIRST 'the permit does not authorize this intent and request pair' (at 837818bc1), then, once the named joins were ordered in front of it, 'intent digest is not the request's founding_intent_digest' (at da51cb3f6 and again at 9236eb5e5 with the two receipt joins split). WHAT THAT ELIMINATES: the four-role activation loop passes, so the earlier CU-based reading of this refusal is REFUTED; all sixteen coordinate joins between Core's intent and the host's request pass; and all thirteen joins between that intent and Custody's realization receipt pass, which covers the four intent coordinates the founding request has no field for -- parent capability root, projected Realize request digest, projected resulting revision, projected Realize receipt digest -- plus the Market state digest. So Core's intent and the supervisor's agree on every coordinate this route can compare, and their SHA-256 digests still differ. The next instrument is a byte-level diff of the two encoded intents: dump the permit's intent bytes on the refusing path and the supervisor's beside them. Owner: PROGRAMS. The campaign writes its evidence document only on completion, so nothing folds and none of the 30 bound routes is corroborated by a run anyone can repeat.
